title: Ancient Grains Bowl

items: 2 cups sweet potato, cut into 1-inch chunks
1 small onion, cut into ½ inch slices
3 cups cooked ancient grains (see recipe), warmed

ingredientGroups.title: Miso Vinaigrette
items: 6 Tbsp (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) rice wine vinegar

ingredientGroups.title: Cilantro Pesto
items: ¼ cup pumpkin seeds, roasted and salted

steps: Prepare the miso vinaigrette by blending until emulsified. Blend the cilantro pesto until smooth. Combine the ancient grains ingredients in a covered baking dish and bake at 375°F for 75–85 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425 degrees F and roast yams, portobello mushrooms, and onions on a lightly oiled baking sheet for 25 minutes.  Remove the vegetables, setting the mushrooms and onions aside.
Decrease the oven to 350, toss the yams in the Miso Vinaigrette, and return to the oven for an additional 10 minutes, or until tender.

To serve, place grain mixture into middle of large serving platter or bowl. Place the miso yams piled onto one side. Pile the blanched snow peas on the opposite side of the yams. Fill in the gaps around the grains with the mushroom-onion mixture and cilantro pesto. Top with quartered avocado pieces
